title: FX Trader Growth Diary
description: A review blog for a 100-day FX challenge: turn ¥100,000 into +¥50,000. Numbers and charts are generated from data and AI writes only the text, so each weekly article ships just by merging a PR.
overviewDesc: Win or lose, write down every decision and lesson - that is the "100-day challenge" this FX trading review blog was built to sustain. Importing a zip exported from my own trade-review app, "Tremiru", automatically displays all trade figures, P&L and chart images straight from the data, while AI writes only a week's worth of prose. A harsh-but-funny critic character, "Toku of the Stop-Out", appears in the articles and on the top page, turning losses into laughs so the diary stays fun to follow.

highlights.title: Data for numbers, AI only for words
highlights.desc: Trade figures, P&L and charts are imported mechanically from the zip, and AI is limited to writing text. Zod-based contract checks and a validation script make CI reject banned phrases, leftover TODOs and invented reasons for entries that have no notes.

highlights.title: Merge a PR, and it's published
highlights.desc: Each week's article JSON becomes a branch and a PR; once the preview looks right and the PR is merged, GitHub Actions builds and deploys to Cloudflare Pages. The infrastructure is managed as code with Terraform to keep upkeep minimal.

highlights.title: Built for SEO, GEO and AEO
highlights.desc: Beyond regular SEO such as structured data and a sitemap, it auto-generates robots.txt and llms.txt for AI crawlers and adds weekly key-point and FAQ structured data, so the site can be found by both search engines and AI search.

timeline.flag: Concept: "data for numbers, AI only for words"
timeline.desc: Keeping a daily FX record meant cutting the writing burden without losing numeric accuracy. I set the rule that numbers and images come from data and AI writes only the text, and started building with Astro, Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Actions.

timeline.flag: Built the import and article validation pipeline
timeline.desc: Wrote scripts to import the Tremiru zip, convert PNGs to WebP and scaffold the weekly article JSON. Added CI checks that protect article quality, including the Sunday-to-Saturday week rule (split at month end) and detection of banned phrases and invented content.

timeline.flag: Designed the challenge pages and cumulative stats
timeline.desc: Created a dark theme and a reader-focused top page. Weekly result cards and cumulative P&L, balance and a gauge toward the goal are now computed automatically from daily data, with the mobile layout polished.

timeline.flag: Polished SEO, GEO, AEO and privacy pages
timeline.desc: Implemented structured data, AI-crawler permissions, llms.txt, FAQPage markup and deferred GA4 loading, plus the privacy policy, disclaimer and contact pages.

timeline.flag: Custom domain and the arrival of "Toku"
timeline.desc: Set up a custom domain to prepare for launch and added an animated Toku who blinks and sighs on the top page. Also set up semi-automated posting to X and an instruction sheet for daily comments, so publishing and sharing run as one flow.

screenshots.title: Top page
screenshots.caption: A hero that says "I'll write about the days I can't win, too," plus challenge progress, cumulative P&L and win rate. Toku, the harsh critic, adds a quick comment.

screenshots.title: 100-day challenge
screenshots.caption: A dashboard of cumulative P&L, balance, distance to the goal, days elapsed, a win-rate ring and overall wins and losses, all computed automatically from daily data.

screenshots.title: Weekly article
screenshots.caption: Each article opens with the week's P&L, win/loss record and win rate alongside the challenge-wide totals, followed by a conclusion-first "key points of the week" section.

screenshots.title: Trade record
screenshots.caption: Numbers and commentary side by side for each trade, with a chart you can switch between 1-minute, 15-minute and 1-hour bars, overlaid with entry, exit, SL and TP.
